known_pitfall_claim: The incidence matrix A has b columns under the orientation used to make A^T A a v×v matrix.
pitfall_counterexample: Let points be {1,2,3} (v=3) and blocks B₁={1,2}, B₂={2,3} (b=2). With rows indexed by blocks and columns by points, A=[[1,1,0],[0,1,1]]. Thus A is 2×3 and has 3 columns, not b=2. Moreover AᵀA=[[1,1,0],[1,2,1],[0,1,1]], which is v×v=3×3 as required.
